units.source_text: 我颤抖起来，默然地走着。

en.t: I began to tremble and walked on in silence.

units.source_text: 你问我：是回到镇上去吗？

en.t: You asked me, Are you going back to town?

units.source_text: 能不能告诉我自行车铺或者汽车铺在哪儿呢？

en.t: Could you tell me where there is a bicycle shop or an automobile shop?

units.source_text: 你还说：很冒昧，其实我是骑摩托车旅行的，

en.t: You also said, Excuse my asking, but I am actually traveling by motorcycle,

units.source_text: 遇上马车，马儿听见摩托车声受惊了，猛闯乱冲，

en.t: and when I came upon a horse cart, the horse was startled by the sound of the motorcycle and bolted wildly,

units.source_text: 我想闪开一条路，不料撞在岩石上，摩托车撞散了架。

en.t: I tried to get out of the way, but unexpectedly crashed into a rock, and the motorcycle was smashed to pieces.
